sentences.en: Juha walked at night and was afraid.
He slept inside a hole on the road.

sentences.ar: ناس مرقوا وسألوه: شو بتعمل هون؟
sentences.en: People passed and asked him: what are you doing here?
They said: and does a dead man talk?
He said: he talks if he is hungry.
